sections.heading: 1. Purpose
sections.content: Define security requirements for AgentAegis employees working remotely.

sections.heading: 2. Network Security
sub_items: VPN required for accessing internal resources
Home WiFi must use WPA2/WPA3 encryption
Public WiFi prohibited for work without VPN
Split tunneling disabled on company devices

sections.heading: 3. Device Security
sub_items: Company-managed devices required for accessing company data
Automatic OS and application updates enabled

sections.heading: 4. Physical Security
sub_items: No work on screens visible to others in public
Secure home office space recommended for calls with sensitive content

sections.heading: 5. Data Handling
sub_items: No company data stored on personal devices
Cloud storage via approved services only
Virtual desktop recommended for sensitive operations
